$comment: Pack Rat bridge trip v1 (Organize, issue #11): one line of <dataDir>/bridge/<adapter-id>/queue.jsonl whose action is "trip". Written only by app/bridge-trip.mts's queueTrip (never by POST /api/bridge, whose command schema has no trip action), read by an adapter bridge that declares "trip" in capabilities.bridge (TazUO only) and re-checked field by field by check_trip in the shared untrusted-input block of every packrat-bridge.py. Draft-07 style within app/schema/validate.mts's keyword subset: roots is a map keyed by container serial, and the validator cannot check keys, so queueTrip and check_trip both check them (decimal serial). Result: bridge.v1.schema.json's result, with steps/partial/stopped. See docs/bridge-protocol.md, Trip.

index.$comment: The trip's number in its plan, printed in game. MAX_TRIP_INDEX in every packrat-bridge.py.

stamp.$comment: The plan's inventoryStamp. The Organize endpoint refuses a trip whose stamp is not the current plan's; the bridge only echoes it.

putAway.$comment: Put away from the backpack (issue #131): the trip takes nothing, and its puts may name items at the top of the backpack as well as the carried set, while the in-game panel's Put away click is recent (packrat-bridge.py). Only the server's Put away handler sets it.

roots.$comment: Container serial (decimal string) -> that ground root's scanned position, sent once per root. Every step's first container must be here, and every entry must be used by a step (queueTrip).

takes.$comment: MAX_TRIP_TAKES in every packrat-bridge.py. Run first, in order: each moves one item from its chain's last container into the backpack at an explicit drop spot.

puts.$comment: MAX_TRIP_PUTS in every packrat-bridge.py. Each moves one item the bridge itself took (its carried set; on a putAway trip, also one at the top of the backpack) into dest's last container.
